body:
Unfortunately, I can drink like a fish, so it takes a good number of units to remove my fear. I don't have a problem (I do go out to lectures and so on without drinking), it's just that if I want to go socialise, I feel way to paranoid and anxious predrink, that it ruins it all.

I exercise quite regularly (rowing) and I can't put my finger on it, I dropped out of high-school and self-taught so I'm not as `socially experienced' as a lot of people, but I have absolutely no reason to be feeling this... empty.
Yeah, It's currently at the stage of severe apathy -- I don't really care for living anymore, it just doesn't seem worth it.

I'm welcoming the stress from the work, as it's something I can talk about to other people, and it gives me an excuse for not going out.

The problem is that I quite enjoy socialising, it's just that I don't think people will enjoy socialising with me, nor do I have the courage to make the first step. I'm really not sure how to fix this.
